name: Palatine Chasmata
origin: One of the Seven Hills of Rome.

name: Padua Chasmata
origin: City in northern Italy founded by Antenor.

name: Eurotas Chasmata
origin: The river on which Sparta stood.

name: Janiculum Dorsa
origin: Hill across the Tiber river from Rome.

name: Fidena Fossae
origin: Town in Latium near Rome.

name: Carthage Fossae
origin: A Punic (Phoenician) city in North Africa.

name: Andromache
origin: Wife of Hector; meets with Aeneas at the cenotaph of Hector in Buthrotum.

name: Drepanum Chasma
origin: Coastal town of Sicily where Aeneas found a safe harbor during a raging storm, and where Anchises died.

name: Latium Chasma
origin: The Trojans' promised land in Italy.

name: Evander
origin: Son of Mercury by Carmentis, ally of Aeneas against the Latins, mythical king of Arcadia, founded and ruled Pallanteum, built on the future site of Rome.

name: Arpi Fossae
origin: Town in Apulia (now Puglia, southern Italy) founded after the Trojan war by Diomedes.

name: Aurunca Chasmata
origin: An old town in Campania.

name: Aufidus Catena
origin: River in the Apulian territory of Diomedes, now called the Ofanto.

name: Clusium Fossae
origin: One of the twelve chief cities of Etruria, situated on the river Clanis.

name: Petelia Fossae
origin: Town of Lucania in southern Italy, founded by Philoctetes.

name: Argiletum Fossae
origin: A district of Rome near the Forum.

name: Pantagias Catenae
origin: River of Sicily.

name: Pactolus Catena
origin: A Lydian river said to carry gold dust after King Midas washed off his golden touch in its waters.

name: Aeneas
origin: Hero of the Aeneid. The son of Anchises and Venus and a member of the royal family of Troy.

name: Tibur Chasmata
origin: Ancient town of Italy (modern name Tivoli) not far from Rome on the river Anio.

name: Larissa Chasma
origin: A town in Thessaly, Achilles' native region.

name: Himella Fossa
origin: A river of the Sabines, affluent of the Tiber.

name: Latinus
origin: King of Latium, husband of Amata.

name: Dido
origin: Tyrian princess who founded Carthage.

name: Alcander
origin: A Trojan defending Aeneas’ camp against the Rutulians, killed by Turnus.

name: Erulus
origin: Superhuman son of the goddess Feronia.

name: Acestes
origin: King of Sicily.

name: Allecto
origin: One of the Furies.

name: Helorus Fossa
origin: A river in southeastern Sicily with wide marshes near its mouth.

name: Turnus
origin: Rutililan king; Aeneas' rival for hand of Lavinia.

name: Ascanius
origin: Son of Aeneas by Creusa.

name: Prytanis
origin: Trojan defending Aeneas' camp against Rutulian attack.

name: Romulus
origin: Mythical founder of Rome in 754 or 753 B.C., son of Mars by Ilia (Rhea Silvia).

name: Sabinus
origin: Fabled ancestor of the Sabines.

name: Dercennus
origin: Ancient king of the Laurentians.

name: Antenor
origin: Nephew of Priam. He escaped the fall of Troy and reached Italy before Aeneas, where he founded Padua.

name: Daucus
origin: A Rutulian, father of the twins Thymber and Larides.

name: Galaesus
origin: An old Italian killed in the first fighting between Latins and Trojans while trying to make peace.

name: Lagus
origin: A soldier of Turnus.

name: Amata
origin: Mother of Lavinia (wife of Aeneas).

name: Silvius
origin: Son of Aeneas and Lavinia.

name: Volcens
origin: A Latin, leader of cavalry sent as reinforcements to Turnus.

name: Phorbas
origin: A Trojan, companion of Aeneas.

name: Pagasus
origin: An Etruscan killed by Camilla.

name: Haemon
origin: There are two persons in the Aeneid with this name: (a) a Rutulian from a group attacking the Trojan’s camp in the absence of Aeneas, and (b) an Italian whose son, priest of Apollo and Diana, was a soldier of Turnus.

name: Entellus
origin: Sicilian boxing champion.

name: Amastrus
origin: A Trojan, victim of Camilla.

name: Remus
origin: He and his brother Romulus founded Rome.

name: Lamyrus
origin: A Rutulian with the troops besieging the camp of Aeneas.

name: Assaracus
origin: Early king of Troy, son of Tros, brother of Ilus and Ganymede.

name: Tiburtus
origin: Brother of the twins Catillus and Coras, founder of Tibur to which he gave his name.

name: Herbesus
origin: A Rutulian who besieged Aeneas' camp.

name: Murranus
origin: A Rutulian.

name: Sulmo
origin: There are two persons in the Aeneid with this name: (a) a Rutulian in the troop of Volcens, and (b) an Italian whose sons fought for Turnus.

name: Iasus
origin: There are two persons in the Aeneid with this name: (a) father of Palinurus, and (b) father of Iapyx.

name: Liger
origin: Soldier of Turnus, brother of Lucagus.

name: Sagaris
origin: Servant of Aeneas.

name: Ilia
origin: Also known as Rhea Silvia; Mother by Mars of Romulus and Remus, the founders of Rome.

name: Mezentius
origin: Etruscan king, ally of Turnus, father of Lausus.

name: Aulestes
origin: Etruscan chief, ally of Aeneas.

name: Caieta
origin: A nurse of Aeneas.

name: Tyrrhus
origin: Keeper of the herds for Latinus, father of Silvia.

name: Anchises
origin: Aeneas' father.

name: Fadus
origin: A Rutulian of those besieging the men of Aeneas in their leader’s absence.

name: Magus
origin: A soldier of Turnus, killed by Aeneas.

name: Lucagus
origin: Soldier of Turnus, brother of Liger.

name: Tereus
origin: A Trojan, killed by Camilla.

name: Phaleris
origin: Trojan defending Aeneas' camp against Rutulian attack.

name: Salius
origin: There are two persons in the Aeneid with this name: (a) a companion of Aeneas and a contestant in the foot race, and (b) a Rutulian.

name: Metiscus
origin: A Rutulian, charioteer of Turnus.

name: Coras
origin: Brother of Tiburtus and twin brother of Catillus. He was founder of Tibur and an ally of Turnus against Aeneas.

name: Catillus
origin: Brother of Tiburtus and twin brother of Coras.

name: Latagus
origin: Soldier of Aeneas.

name: Telon
origin: Ruler of the Teleboans on Capri; father of Oebalus.

name: Hector
origin: Trojan prince and warrior, son of King Priam and Queen Hecuba; appears to Aeneas as a ghost in a dream, warning him that Troy has fallen and that he should flee.

name: Massicus
origin: An Etruscan ally of Aeneas.

name: Adrastus
origin: King of Argos, one of the seven against Thebes, and the only one to return alive.

name: Creusa
origin: Daughter of Priam; first wife of Aeneas.

name: Italus
origin: Ancient hero, eponymous ancestor of the Italians.

name: Oebalus
origin: An ally of Turnus, son of Telon and Sebethis.

name: Halys
origin: A Trojan defending Aeneas' camp against the Rutulian attack. He was killed by Turnus.

name: Eumelus
origin: A Trojan companion of Aeneas.

name: Butes
origin: A famous boxer who had been defeated by Dares.

name: Euryalus
origin: A Trojan companion of Aeneas, friend of Nisus.

name: Nisus
origin: Trojan companion of Aeneas, friend of Euryalus.

name: Ripheus
origin: A Trojan. He fought at the side of Aeneas during Troy's last night.

name: Camilla
origin: A warrior maiden; ally of Turnus.

name: Cretheus
origin: A Trojan warrior who took part in the defense of Aeneas’ camp against the Rutulians.

name: Larides
origin: A Rutulian, member of Turnus’ army, son of Daucus, twin brother of Thymber.

name: Amycus
origin: A Trojan, comrade of Aeneas.

name: Thymber
origin: A Rutulian, member of Turnus’ army, son of Daucus, twin brother of Larides.

name: Lausus
origin: Son of Mezentius, killed by Aeneas.

name: Anna
origin: Sister and confidante of Dido.

name: Cassandra
origin: Daughter of Priam; she could foretell the future.

name: Palinurus
origin: Pilot of Aeneas' fleet.
